study_plan.focus: Module 5 - Linear Algebra and Numerical Methods
tasks: Review Matrix Rank and Echelon Form.
Practice Consistency of Linear Systems (with/without parameters).
Practice Solving Linear Systems using Gauss-Jordan Method.
Practice Solving Linear Systems using Gauss-Seidel Iteration Method.
Study Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors (Power Method).
Review Exact Differential Equations and Integrating Factors.
Practice Differential Equations Solvable for p (Clairaut's Form & Reducible).
Practice finding Orthogonal Trajectories of Curves.
Study Applications of First-Order Linear Differential Equations (e.g., Newton's Law of Cooling, L-R circuits).
Review Polar Coordinates and related curves.
Practice deriving Pedal Equation of Polar Curves.
Practice finding the Angle between Two Polar Curves.
Study Radius of Curvature (Cartesian and Polar forms).
Understand Maclaurin's and Taylor's Series expansions.
Practice Partial Differentiation (Chain Rule for Composite Functions).
Practice finding Extreme Values of Multivariable Functions.
Practice Limits using L'Hopital's Rule (Indeterminate Forms).
Understand Jacobians and their properties.
Review Euler's Theorem for Homogeneous Functions.
Study Scalar and Vector fields, and their properties.
Understand Gradient, Divergence, and Curl of scalar/vector fields.
Practice identifying Solenoidal and Irrotational fields.
Review basic concepts of Line Integrals.
Quick revision of all key formulas and concepts from Modules 1-5.
Solve 2-3 past paper questions from each module, prioritizing the most repeated questions.
Self-assess weak areas and do a final brush-up.

notes: The latest official scheme for BMATS101, now referred to as 1BMATS101 (Calculus and Linear Algebra: CSE Stream), is the VTU 2025 Scheme.

Recent syllabus changes for 1BMATS101 include the introduction of 'Vector Spaces' and 'Linear Transformations' as new modules (Modules 4 and 5) for the first semester Computer Science branches, effective from 2025.
The syllabus for 1BMATS101 under the 2025 scheme covers Calculus, Vector Calculus, System of Linear Equations, Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors, Vector Spaces, and Linear Transformations.
VTU has released a draft timetable for the Semester End Examination for UG and PG Courses for December 2026/January 2027.
A revised timetable for the VII-Semester B.E./B.Tech. Examination for December 2026/January 2027 has also been circulated.
